title: ADF Integration Runtime Health
dataSources: ADF pipeline/activity run diagnostics (`azure:datafactory`), integration-runtime metrics, and REST API run history.
app: Azure Data Factory diagnostic logs to Splunk via the Azure Monitor Add-on / Event Hub; ADF REST API pipeline-run queries via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=azure:datafactory category="IntegrationRuntimeStatus"
| stats latest(status) as status, latest(available_memory_pct) as mem_pct, latest(cpu_pct) as cpu by integration_runtime, node_name
| where status!="Online" OR cpu>85 OR mem_pct<10
| sort integration_runtime
description: Monitors the health of ADF self-hosted and Azure integration runtimes, flagging offline nodes or nodes running hot on CPU/memory that will throttle copy activities.
value: The integration runtime is the engine behind every ADF copy and data-flow; an unhealthy node slows or fails all pipelines that use it.
implementation: Stream ADF diagnostics via Azure Monitor/Event Hub; schedule every 10 minutes and alert on offline or resource-saturated runtime nodes.
visualization: Table of runtime node by status and resource, status panel.

references.title: Azure Data Factory — Monitor with Azure Monitor
Microsoft Add-on for Splunk / Azure Monitor

grandmaExplanation: We watch the engines that move data in and out of Azure and warn you when one is offline or overloaded.
